prompt.generated_prompt_string: Daily vlog snapshot style with iPhone original-camera texture, slight motion blur, casual life-snapshot framing, low-quality graininess, and an authentic unpretentious daily feel. An 18-year-old adult dance student with straight smooth black wavy hair, bangs, fair moist skin, and a small pink cherry-blossom hair clip wakes barefoot in a cozy bedroom. She wears an oversized beige knitted cardigan arranged naturally over a simple top. Plush teddy bears and bunny dolls are piled on the bed, the quilt is slightly messy, a warm yellow table lamp and manga books sit on the bedside table, and sunlight streams through white curtains. From 0-5 seconds, use a 45-degree side upper-body close-up as she stretches, rubs her eyes, yawns, and looks drowsy. From 5-10 seconds, zoom slightly as she arranges her bangs and turns toward camera with a soft smile. From 10-15 seconds, she hugs a plush teddy bear and gently waves while saying, "Good morning." Keep candid grain, natural movement, and photorealistic skin and lighting detail.
